results.title: Saint Paisios
results.overview: The story of Saint Paisios, or else known as Arsenios Eznepidis. After being uprooted from Farasa of Cappadocia as refugees, the family of young Arsenios settles in Konitsa, Epirus where he grows up with his mother and grandmother, who inherit to him their deep faith in Christ as well as their love for all people. Fast forward to many years later, his time in Mounth Athos and his move to Filotheos monastery play a catalytic role in his religious journey. Eventually, he sends a photograph of himself to his mother, bidding her farewell and telling her that from then on the Virgin Mary will be his mother. He no longer signs using the name Arsenios, but Paisios.

results.title: Oru Durooha Saahacharyathil
results.overview: Humble health care worker Sethu lives a quiet life caring for his sick brother — until a mysterious armed fugitive seeks refuge in his home.

results.title: The Kidnapping of a President
results.overview: In October 1930, a group of officers belonging to the Finnish army's top leadership decided, after a night of drinking, to kidnap Finland's retired first president, Ståhlberg. The Finnish people were divided in the aftermath of the civil war, and the political atmosphere was turbulent and tense. However, the kidnapping went wrong right from the start when the incompetent henchmen recruited for the job were forced to take the president's stubborn wife, Ester Ståhlberg, with them.

results.title: Black Star
results.overview: Angela struggles to release her album while staying true to herself. After being rejected by a record label, she faces a dilemma: betray her essence to be accepted in the music industry, or embrace an unexpected proposal to finance her album and produce her music the way she truly wants.

results.title: Jhaad Phoonk
results.overview: Jhaad Phoonk is a horror-drama directed by Rajan Ramgopal Verma. The movie features Padmini Kolhapure, Sumbul Touqeer, Yashpal Sharma, and Harsh Rajput in pivotal roles.

results.title: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
results.overview: After surviving a devastating plane crash that nearly took his life, legendary and electrifying drummer Travis Barker embarks on a raw and redemptive journey in this intimate portrait of the man behind the tattoos who transformed pain into power.

results.title: Corporate Retreat
results.overview: Blending the dread of survival horror with dark laughs and shocking twists, "Corporate Retreat" centers around a group of young executives whose luxury team-building trip descends into a bloody fight for survival against a vengeful retreat leader.

results.title: Baa Baa Black Sheep
results.overview: One misplaced object triggers a one-day chain reaction, pulling six strangers into a fun, chaotic journey. As it changes hands, small mistakes lead to comic misunderstandings, awkward encounters, and unexpected connections that change all their lives.

results.title: Governor
results.overview: Set against Indias 1990 economic crisis, Governor follows Raman, a reluctant bureaucrat unexpectedly appointed as the Governor of the RBI when the nation stands on the brink of bankruptcy. As inflation rises, fuel runs low, and panic spreads, Raman must navigate political pressure and a collapsing system to prevent the country from falling apart.

results.title: NXT Vengeance Day 2026
results.overview: The 2026 Vengeance Day was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE for its NXT brand, held on March 7, 2026, at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida, and was headlined by Joe Hendry (c) vs. Ricky Saints for the NXT Championship.

results.title: Signal One
results.overview: After meeting face-to-face with the punk scene in 1977s West Berlin, a Yugoslav philosophy student has to learn how to confront and accept the person he really is.

results.title: Tote Oma
results.overview: German Democratic Republic, 1989: Margot leads a quiet, orderly life with her party-loyal husband. Every day is the same between household chores, television and the same familiar rituals. In a world that promises her security and stability, the monotony of her daily life becomes increasingly noticeable. A young neighbor and a goldfish bring movement into Margot’s rigid routine.

results.title: Biermann
results.overview: Portrait of the German-German singer-songwriter and intellectual Wolf Biermann, whose famous Cologne concert in 1976 made German history.

results.title: Time and Water
results.overview: Facing the death of his country’s glaciers and the loss of his beloved grandparents, Icelandic writer Andri Snær Magnason turns his archives into a time capsule to hold what is slipping away — family, memory, time, and water.

results.title: He Calls Me Daughter
results.overview: An exploration of women shaped by absent or broken fathers as they find healing, courage, and restored identity through God’s faithful love. Through raw and powerful stories, HE CALLS ME DAUGHTER reveals a timeless truth: A heavenly Father changes everything.

results.title: La Esquina tá en Candela
results.overview: When a man bursts into a grocery store armed and demanding to talk with somebody, an ordinary afternoon turns into chaos in the neighborhood.

results.title: Junction Row
results.overview: Juno is a recovering addict who leaves a fringe housing compound for a better life, leaving her beloved Ruby behind. When she learns that Ruby has gone missing, Juno returns, only to find Junction Row has become a hotbed of criminal activity, but she encounters much more than menacing drug dealers on her mission to find Ruby.

results.title: Crimson Cove
results.overview: Outsiders on a bachelor trip arrive in a close-knit beach town where locals fiercely protect their territory. Tensions erupt, hidden traumas surface, and survival becomes a nightmarish spiral into madness.

results.title: Her Silence
results.overview: An international student hosts her visiting parents in her Sydney flat, and spends two fraught days wrestling with her mother’s unspoken apprehensions about the life her daughter has chosen to build in Australia.
